description.value:
A wave of restorative energy rolls out from a point you choose within range. Choose up to six creatures within a 30-foot-radius sphere centered there; each regains hit points equal to 3d8 plus your forcecasting ability modifier. Droids and constructs gain no benefit.

Cast with a 6th-level slot or higher, the healing increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Light Side Powers, Level 5
